thresholds.trigger_condition: required artifact category is absent for the selected pack variant
thresholds.required_action: restore the missing required artifact before review completion

thresholds.trigger_condition: blocked reason exists without mapped evidence checklist
thresholds.required_action: create or restore the evidence checklist mapping

thresholds.trigger_condition: governance communication QA checklist contains one or more failed mandatory checks
thresholds.required_action: correct QA failures and rerun static review

thresholds.trigger_condition: mismatch remains undocumented or is not an approved sentinel
thresholds.required_action: document the mismatch as preserved sentinel or align the affected fields

thresholds.trigger_condition: active Envoy v0.2.8 security triage constraint remains unresolved for release-facing posture
thresholds.required_action: preserve no-release boundary until triage is resolved or formally waived

thresholds.trigger_condition: release-readiness packet lacks required signoff or active constraints are unresolved
thresholds.required_action: defer release readiness and resolve blockers before reconsideration

thresholds.trigger_condition: trust blocked, tenant violation, or equivalent terminal governance state exists
thresholds.required_action: halt progression and escalate through the terminal governance lane

thresholds.trigger_condition: required signoff record is missing, expired, or incomplete
thresholds.required_action: complete or renew the required signoff record
